findings.fix: Restructure the section to track one actor or process at a time. Either organize by actor (what Finance does, what you do, what Payroll does) or by process stage (intake, reconciliation, release). findings.violation: The Terminology Notes section shifts its grammatical subject in nearly every clause with no connecting thread. Line 51 moves from 'You record' (employee as subject) to 'Finance reconciles' (Finance as subject) to 'Payroll releases' (Payroll as subject), then line 53 reverts to 'you submit'. The reader has to track four different actors performing four different actions with no stated relationship between them, disrupting topic continuity at every sentence boundary.
